description: LIFO PERPETUAL CONSUMES THE NEWEST LAYER THAT EXISTED AT THE MOMENT OF THE ISSUE. The receipts are the same three layers as fixture 08: PUR-1 10.0000 @ 100.0000 = 1000.0000, PUR-2 10.0000 @ 120.0000 = 1200.0000, PUR-3 5.0000 @ 80.0000 = 400.0000. SAL-1 issues 15.0000 on 05-Apr and takes ALL of PUR-2, the newest layer then in existence (1200.0000), then 5.0000 of PUR-1 at 100.0000 (500.0000) -> consumed 1700.0000, leaving 5.0000 units of PUR-1 at 500.0000. SAL-2 issues 8.0000 on 07-Apr, by when PUR-3 exists and is the newest: all of PUR-3 (400.0000) plus 3.0000 of PUR-1 at 100.0000 (300.0000) -> consumed 700.0000. Closing 2.0000 units of the ORIGINAL layer, at 200.0000, rate 100.0000. Total consumed 2400.0000. Conservation: 0 + 2600.0000 - 2400.0000 = 200.0000. 40.0000 of this item's cost of goods sold is the METHOD and nothing else (FIFO consumed 2440.0000). NOTE WHAT THIS IS NOT: ANNUAL LIFO would cost an April issue at a purchase made the following March - a figure that cannot be stated until the year closes and that changes every time a later purchase is keyed. This is the perpetual variant, which is the only one a movement replay can express without restating an interim Profit & Loss.
